title: Import users
description: Create accounts in bulk: build the user list below, review the preview, then import.
formatHelp: Each row is one account. Email, username, and password are required; the remaining columns are optional. Usernames are 3–31 characters (or exactly 2 Chinese characters) and passwords are 6–255 characters.
columns: Column order for files and pasted text: email, username, password, display name, extra details. A single-column file is treated as a username list, or an email list when the values contain @.
extraHelp: The extra details column accepts a JSON object such as {example}; other keys are kept unchanged. A plain value that is not JSON is treated as a group name. Group, school, and student ID have their own columns in the table and apply to the current domain.
passwordHelp: Passwords are hidden from the preview. Use Download TSV to keep a copy of the list before importing.
fileEmpty: The file did not contain any user rows.
fileFailed: Could not read the file. Check that it is a valid CSV, TSV, TXT, or XLSX file.
clearDescription: This removes all {count} rows from the table.
emptyHelp: Load a CSV, TSV, TXT, or XLSX file, paste a list, generate usernames, or add rows manually.
missingFields: {count} rows are missing an email, username, or password. The server reports them as skipped lines in the preview.
required: Add at least one user before previewing.
tooLarge: The user list is too large to submit (server limit: 65536 characters). Split it into smaller batches.
failed: The request could not be completed.
retryNotice: Some accounts may already have been created. Preview again before retrying.
previewHelp: Review the messages below. Import processes valid rows only; invalid rows are skipped. Line numbers match the # column in the table. To include missing users, fix the rows and preview again.
resultHelp: The import request finished. Review the server messages for skipped rows or creation errors. The “users found” count describes validated entries, not confirmed account creations.

usernames.title: Generate usernames
usernames.description: Create usernames from a prefix plus a running number, for example team001, team002, … Rows without an email get '<'username'>'@ycoj.local.

passwords.title: Fill passwords
passwords.description: Give every row the same password, or generate a random password for each user.
passwords.passwordInvalid: Enter a password between 6 and 255 characters.
passwords.emptyOnly: Only fill rows that do not have a password yet

paste.title: Paste user list
paste.description: Paste rows copied from a spreadsheet or CSV text. One user per line; use the column order from the format guide.
paste.empty: Paste at least one row first.
